about: Gate 22 (the engine line) now analyses the Opera Game once per block in its TC-R105 and TC-R116 blocks: the first launch of each block analyses the game from nothing, as before, and the later launches are seeded with that analysis (gates/drive/review.js shareAnalysis, keyed on the bundle md5, the PGN and ct_pool/ct_engdet/ct_gdepth), so the app takes its own cache path. Graded: every TC-R105 and TC-R116 line, in the fresh first launch and in the seeded launches after it, so a seeded launch is shown to be no blinder than a fresh one. The breaks are app defects those blocks exist for: the board shrinking whenever the engine line is on (the board moves when the line is toggled), and the engine line's plain-words reading that a tap no longer closes. The whole gate runs, about 12 minutes a try. NOT COVERED: the other blocks of gate 22 are unchanged and keep their fresh analyses, so they are not graded here.

breaks.name: board-shrinks-with-the-engine-line
breaks.why: the Review board loses 8px of width whenever the engine line is on, so switching the line on moves the board (what TC-R116 exists to catch)

breaks.name: engine-reading-does-not-close
breaks.why: a tap on the engine line's plain-words reading no longer closes it
